name: mythic-brain
description: Tennyson's centralized skills, agents, hooks, and MCP configurations. Skills use the open SKILL.md format, so Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents share them. In Claude Code: enable once at user or organization scope; per-repo .claude/settings.json only for exceptions.

plugins.name: brand-systems
plugins.description: The Mythic Labs method: Discovery, Architecture, Shadow, and Expression for products, brands, and audiences, plus voice audits. Jungian structural identity work, evidence-bound.

plugins.name: dev-workflows
plugins.description: PR review, security audit, deploy helpers, CI autofix patterns, and the roadmap loop autonomous build agents use to take, build, report and discuss tasks from the dashboard, and to propose work to its inbox. Bundles MCP access to GitHub, Supabase, and Vercel where applicable.

plugins.name: content-ops
plugins.description: Design generation, site building, asset pipelines. MCP access to Canva, Wix, and Google Drive.

plugins.name: comms
plugins.description: Inbox triage, calendar scheduling, meeting prep. MCP access to Gmail and Google Calendar.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Scholarly literature search, citation lookup, and persistent thought capture. MCP access to article databases and the thought store.
